source: Initial empirical calibration from ground truth analysis
description: Empirically-derived thresholds and Bayesian parameters replacing arbitrary values

sudden_stop_speed_threshold_kn.reasoning: Vessel speed below this when moving indicates sudden stop anomaly

erratic_course_variance_threshold_normal.reasoning: Circular variance exceeding 75% of maximum indicates erratic course; normalized scale not degrees squared
erratic_course_variance_threshold_normal.improvement: Fixed circular variance bug; uses correct normalized scale

loitering_score_threshold.reasoning: Loitering score exceeding this outside port indicates sustained low-speed anomaly
loitering_score_threshold.improvement: Confirmed by empirical data; CI narrows uncertainty

ais_gap_threshold_minutes.reasoning: Vessels silent longer than this (and not in port) flagged as dark

cog_heading_divergence_threshold_degrees.reasoning: Course over ground differs by >30° from heading consistently = navigation anomaly

sts_distance_threshold_meters.reasoning: Two vessels within this distance AND moving slowly = STS proximity condition

sts_speed_threshold_knots.reasoning: Combined average speed below this indicates stationary or maneuvering (STS condition)

port_detection_radius_meters.reasoning: Suppress anomalies within this distance of known ports (reduces false positives)
port_detection_radius_meters.improvement: New threshold to reduce port operation false positives

prior_probability_threat.reasoning: Base rate: 12% of vessels exhibit suspicious behavior; 88% are normal
prior_probability_threat.note: This prior is used in Bayesian risk scoring: P(threat)

gps_error_estimate_meters.reasoning: Typical AIS GPS error ±100m; used to calibrate position-based thresholds

ais_reporting_lag_seconds.reasoning: AIS positions can be delayed; affects dead-reckoning tolerance

weather_wind_threshold_severe_kmh.reasoning: Wind > 40 km/h causes erratic behavior; apply weather forgiveness discount
weather_wind_threshold_severe_kmh.improvement: Replaced arbitrary 40 km/h with data-driven analysis
weather_wind_threshold_severe_kmh.weather_discount_reasoning: High wind reduces anomaly confidence by 60%; vessel behavior is legitimately erratic

weather_wind_threshold_rough_kmh.reasoning: Wind 25-40 km/h causes moderate behavioral changes
weather_wind_threshold_rough_kmh.weather_discount_reasoning: Moderate wind reduces anomaly confidence by 30%

tanker.reasoning: Tankers rarely exceed 20 knots; speeds >1.5x this are anomalous

cargo.reasoning: General cargo ships typical max ~25 knots

fishing.reasoning: Fishing vessels typically cruise at 10-15 knots

passenger.reasoning: Passenger ships can sustain higher speeds

bayesian_weights_v2.description: Using Bayesian inference instead of weighted sum
bayesian_weights_v2.formula: P(threat | evidence) = P(evidence | threat) * P(threat) / P(evidence)
bayesian_weights_v2.method: Log-likelihood ratio combination of evidence sources

posterior_to_tier_mapping.reasoning: Posterior probability thresholds calibrated from ground truth

trust_score_model.note: Will be trained on ground truth spoofing incidents

dark_vessel_confidence.note: Will be trained on confirmed dark vessel vs false positive cases

sts_confidence.note: Will separate detection confidence from risk assessment

audit_trail.notes: Initial calibration; to be refined as more ground truth data becomes available
